messages.subject: Rattle 2.6.21 released
parts:
A new version Rattle has been released and is now available from CRAN.

To upgrade, start up R and:

> install.packages("rattle")

One of the major changes is that the Advanced Graphics option is now
on by default. Various plots are migrating to making use of the
ggplot2 package. Previous behaviour is restored by unselecting the
option in the Settings menu. Not all plots have been migrated yet.

Since the last announcement (2.6.17) there have also been many bug fixes.

A full change log is available as

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/ChangeLog

A development version (updated more regularly) is available directly
from the Togaware repository:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

As always feedback, comments, suggestions are always welcome.

Regards,
Graham
